description: This file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android application. It sets up a browse interface with multiple rows showing various workout-related data, including daily workouts, recommendations, progress charts, badges, and profile options. The fragment handles UI setup, data binding, and navigation interactions.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Primary class for the home screen, extending BrowseSupportFragment, managing multiple rows of workout content, badges, progress, and profile options.

classes.name: HomeFragment.StringPresenter
classes.description: Inner class used to create and bind simple string-based cards for profile and goals options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, setting up UI, data rows, and event listeners.

methods.name: setupUi
methods.description: Configures visual aspects of the UI, including title, colors, headers, and search listener.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Constructs multiple rows for the browse UI, including daily workouts, recommended workouts, progress charts, badges, and profile options.

methods.name: setupEventListeners
methods.description: Registers click listeners for items, handling navigation to other fragments or starting activities.
